INSERT INTO products (id, name, description, basePrice, thumbnailUrl, category, isPrintOnDemand, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES
(30004, 'Skull Wrench Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker featuring the iconic skull with wrench. Weather-resistant, perfect for helmets, tanks, and toolboxes.', 5.00, '/images/products/skull-sticker.png', 'stickers', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30005, 'Flesh to Death Flag Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker of the classic F2D pennant flag. Slap it anywhere that needs more attitude.', 5.00, '/images/products/flag-sticker.png', 'stickers', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30006, 'Honey Jar Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker of the Flesh to Death honey jar. Sweet and rebellious.', 5.00, '/images/products/jar-sticker.png', 'stickers', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30007, 'Poker Chip Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker of the F2D poker chip. For those who gamble with fate.', 5.00, '/images/products/chip-sticker.png', 'stickers', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30008, 'Bee Head Sticker', 'Die-cut vinyl sticker of the biker bee mascot. The face of the hive.', 5.00, '/images/products/bee-head-sticker.png', 'stickers', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30009, 'F2D Sticker Pack', 'Complete set of all 5 Flesh to Death stickers. Save $10 when you buy the pack.', 15.00, '/images/products/sticker-pack.png', 'stickers', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30010, 'Skull Wrench Patch', 'Embroidered iron-on patch featuring the skull with wrench. 3.5" diameter.', 12.00, '/images/products/skull-patch.png', 'patches', true, true, NOW(), NOW()),
(30011, 'F2D Circle Badge Patch', 'Embroidered iron-on patch of the classic circle badge logo. 4" diameter.', 14.00, '/images/products/badge-patch.png', 'patches', true, true, NOW(), NOW());
